changes: First Modwerk release for the MS-70CDR: Manro's Loop 0.03, built with no code from Zoom's effects. Record, play, overdub, undo and redo from the footswitch, with tempo-quantized loops and a click.
Add it to your set and sync the set from the pedal page over USB, or install it with Zoom Effect Manager.
A recalled patch plays the knobs' defaults until you touch a knob.
